name: Bad Attitude
overview: Scripture warns against harboring a bad attitude, emphasizing trust in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding (Proverbs 3:5). Harsh words and anger provoke conflict and judgment, while gentle responses promote peace (Proverbs 15:1; Matthew 5:22). The Bible calls believers to reject scorn and contention, pursuing transformation through the renewing of the mind to live according to God's perfect will (Proverbs 22:10; Romans 12:2). A hardened heart leads away from righteousness, but the upright direct their ways in accordance with God’s truth (Proverbs 21:29).
